title: Vesopa Go
short_description: Orders and payments anywhere in your venue, at the counter or the table.
full_description:
Vesopa Go puts your Vesopa EPOS till in your pocket. Take orders and payments anywhere in the venue, at the counter, at the table or out on the terrace, and everything lands in the same back office as your tills.

At the table
• See the floor plan live: which tables are seated, ordering, waiting or paying
• Seat a table, add covers and order from the venue's real menu, with modifiers, choices and allergens
• Send to the kitchen in one tap; courses are fired when you say
• Open bills are shared with the tills: start a bill on the phone, finish it at the bar, or the other way round

At the counter
• A quick, clear sell screen for bars, cafés, pop-ups and events
• Quick sale for a typed amount
• Cash with change shown, or card

Card payments
• Vesopa Tap to Pay: take contactless cards on the phone itself, where enabled for your venue
• Or send the payment to the venue's card machine (Dojo, Stripe Terminal or Teya)
• QR Pay: guests scan the bill and pay with their own phone
• Refunds need a manager's PIN, every time

On your TV
• Android TV and Google TV: Vesopa Go runs as the kitchen board or the customer display, driven by the remote
• Nothing to type: the TV shows a code, you scan it with a phone that is signed in, and choose what the screen is for
• Kitchen board: every ticket the same size, oldest first, allergens and notes in plain sight, done with the remote's OK
• Customer display: the bill as it is rung up, the total, card and QR payments, and your own adverts when it is quiet

Live and fast
• A live connection to the back office: orders, bills, the kitchen and menu changes arrive the moment they happen
• Keeps working through a dropped signal and sends the sales when it is back

Sales and reports
• Today's receipts, emailed receipts and refunds
• The day's takings by payment type and category, and End of day

Secure sign-in
• Sign in with your venue's Vesopa account, then staff use their own PIN, staff card or fingerprint
• Delete your Vesopa account from More whenever you want to

New to Vesopa? Register your venue in the app and start a 14-day free trial, or tap Try the demo to look round first.
release_notes: Vesopa Go 1.2.32: kitchen tickets all the same size, with tap to see the whole ticket; name each kitchen and choose the venue sites it cooks for, from the device, the till or the back office; a kitchen printer; and a Network and hardware page for kitchen and customer display devices.
